contentText:
In what world does Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time Remake get canceled amid corporate restructurin g and yet BG&E2 does not?

"Beyond Good & Evil 2 remains a priority for us in the context of our strategy centered around Open World Adventures," an unnamed Ubisoft spokesperson told Kotaku and Insider Gaming .

The original Beyond Good & Evil is a fantastic game I can enjoy even now, over 20 years on from its 2003 release.

The sequel has been in development hell nearly as long at over 17 years, the longest of any major game; it's survived the retirement of its first creative director , the death of its second creative director , and that on …
